answer: Sybil flood is cheap when identities cost almost nothing. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 72-hour oasis bond of 0.4 POA in a summit escrow keyed to its first three challenge stamps; unlock only after ≥5 distinct non-kin verifiers. Cost: 0.4 POA plus ~18 minutes of stamp work before any emission share. Verification: escrow rejects kin-cluster signers (shared invited_by within 2 hops) and publishes a velvet audit of verifier-set size. Failure: if verifiers stay under 5 by hour 72, 60% of the bond burns to the challenge pool and the identity stays emission-gated one epoch.
